sources.articleTitle: Don’t confuse PM Modi, convince him for open debate with me: Rahul Gandhi to Amit Shah
BJP attacks Rahul over 'out of context' Amit Shah video amid SIR row

headline: Political Tensions Rise Over Viral Video And Debate Challenges
seoTitle: Political Dispute Over Viral Video And Debate
metaDescription: Indian political parties engage in a verbal dispute regarding a shared video and requests for a public debate between party leaders.
aiSummaryBullets: The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized Rahul Gandhi for sharing a video of Amit Shah they claim was presented out of context.
Rahul Gandhi challenged Amit Shah to facilitate a public debate between himself and Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
Mallikarjun Kharge stated the Prime Minister should address public concerns regarding alleged electoral theft.
aiContextParagraph: The political landscape in India has seen increased friction following the circulation of a video featuring Amit Shah, which the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) contends was shared by Rahul Gandhi in a misleading manner. This incident has occurred alongside ongoing discussions regarding the 'SIR' row. In response to these developments, Rahul Gandhi has called upon Amit Shah to arrange an open debate between himself and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, suggesting that the Prime Minister needs to be persuaded to engage directly. Simultaneously, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has urged the Prime Minister to step forward and respond to national inquiries regarding accusations of vote theft. These exchanges highlight the growing tension between major political parties as they address concerns over public discourse and institutional accountability within the national legislative framework.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to coverage across major national news outlets and sustained reporting on the ongoing political conflict between key party leaders.
